news.analysis: Taylor opened this divisional matchup with a 19-yard run on the Colts' first play from scrimmage. After that, the star running back, who is surrounded by trade rumors, did very little. This one got out of hand early for the Colts, as they trailed 28-0 going into halftime. That led to fewer touches for Taylor and, easily, his weakest output of the season for fantasy managers.

news.analysis: Herbert had another poor showing on Sunday. He threw two interceptions and wasn't able to lead the Chargers to a single touchdown over the Rams, and the team now drops to a dismal 0-7 on the season as a result. He should not be rostered or started in any league formats as this nightmare season continues for the Chargers.

news.contents: The Baltimore Ravens have placed kicker Tyler Loop (groin) on Injured Reserve, per ESPN's Adam Schefter. Loop will now miss at least the next four games for Baltimore as a result, leaving him first eligible to return in Week 14 following the Ravens' Week 13 bye. Across eight games before getting injured, Loop made 13 of 17 field goal attempts and all 18 of his extra point tries. news.analysis: Parsons made his return to practice on Wednesday after missing an extended period of time while recovering from a significant knee injury. He was limited in his first day back, and he is unlikely to be ready to play in Week 9. Still, his return should come soon, which will offer a significant boost for Green Bay's defensive front moving forward.

news.contents: Green Bay Packers edge rusher Micah Parsons (knee) is scheduled to practice Wednesday for the first time since suffering a torn ACL and meniscus injury last December, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter. The 27-year-old has spent the entire 2026 season on the physically unable to perform list while recovering from reconstructive knee surgery.
